I won’t bury the lede here; the Priority E-Coast is priced at US $1,999. That’s on the higher end of the spectrum for beach cruiser e-bikes, but you’re about to see why. [Note: For the next five days you can save $300 with the Black Friday sale by using code MOBF15 at checkout].

cls.quote: The e-Coast ships Class 2 with a max speed of 20 mph. Using the display, it can be re-programmed to Class 3 with a max speed of 28 mph using pedal assist. Please check your local regulations. The maximum speed using the throttle is limited to 20 mph and is not re-programmable. ⟶ What should I expect in terms of water and rust-resistance?

wh.quote: The Priority 500-watt motor is powered by a 576 watt-hour battery that's integrated into the rear rack, keeping the lines of The e-Coast super clean. The battery is easily removable and can be charged on or off the bike. The integrated rack is perfect for loading up all your essentials for a day at the beach, or wherever you plan to set sail. eBike battery UL 2271 certified by SGS. Please review NYC Lithium-Ion Battery Safety information.
Range: Up to 32-96 km (20-60 mi) ⟶ Battery: 48V 12Ah (576 Wh)
